name: Navigation
description: Items, headings and dividers that go inside a drawer or sidebar.

classes.description: Icon-and-label row, as a link or button. Active with aria-current, data-active, .active or .selected; disabled with .disabled, [disabled] or aria-disabled="true".
The item's text. Truncates, and fades out inside a sidebar rail.
Section title above a group of items. Lines up with the labels and fades out in a rail.
Rule between groups of items. Works on an <hr> or a <div>.
No fill until hovered or active, for dense lists.
